checklist.title: Transient storage edge gas charging and transaction-scoped semantics
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 12 edges in GRAPH-EIP-1153-TRANSIENT-STORAGE (EDGE-TSTORE-GAS through EDGE-TRANSIENT-REVERT). 2. Verify EDGE-TSTORE-GAS and EDGE-TLOAD-GAS charge exactly 100 gas (WarmStorageReadCost). 3. Confirm EDGE-TRANSIENT-CLEAR correctly clears transient storage at transaction end. 4. Verify EDGE-TRANSIENT-REVERT restores transient storage state on call reversion. 5. Check that no edge allows transient data to persist across transaction boundaries.
checklist.notes: EIP-1153 transient storage is per-transaction only. Edges must enforce 100 gas cost and proper cleanup. Revert semantics differ from persistent storage.

checklist.title: MCOPY safe memory-to-memory copy with overlap handling
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate MCOPY opcode handler in core/vm/instructions.go. 2. Review the 6 nodes from STATE-MCOPY-START to STATE-MCOPY-COMPLETE. 3. Verify that memory expansion is computed and charged before copy. 4. Confirm overlapping regions are handled correctly (Go's copy() builtin handles this). 5. Test with overlapping source/destination ranges: dest < src, dest > src, dest == src.
checklist.notes: EIP-5656 MCOPY must handle overlapping memory regions correctly. Go's copy() provides memmove semantics. Gas = 3 + 3*ceil(length/32) + memory expansion.

checklist.title: MCOPY gas calculation including memory expansion costs
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review the 5 edges from EDGE-MCOPY-START to EDGE-MCOPY-DONE. 2. Verify gas calculation: base cost (3) + word cost (3 * ceil(length/32)) + memory expansion. 3. Confirm memory expansion is calculated using memoryMcopy function. 4. Check that gas is deducted before copy execution. 5. Verify stack underflow protection for 3 arguments (dest, src, length).
checklist.notes: Memory expansion cost follows standard quadratic formula. Gas must be charged before state modification.

checklist.title: EIP-1559 base fee calculation correctness
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 10 nodes in GRAPH-EIP-1559-FEE-MARKET. 2. Locate CalcBaseFee function in consensus/misc/eip1559.go. 3. Verify formula: baseFee += (parentBaseFee * gasUsedDelta) / (gasTarget * baseFeeChangeDenominator). 4. Confirm max change is capped at 12.5% (denominator = 8). 5. Check boundary conditions: parentGasUsed == gasTarget, parentGasUsed == 0, parentGasUsed == gasLimit*2. 6. Verify ACTION-1559-BURN-BASE-FEE burns base fee (does not credit coinbase).
checklist.notes: EIP-1559 base fee adjustment must be exactly 12.5% max. Incorrect calculation breaks consensus. Base fee is burned, not paid to miner.

checklist.title: EIP-1559 fee flow - base fee burning and priority fee payment
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 12 edges in GRAPH-EIP-1559-FEE-MARKET. 2. Trace EDGE-1559-BURN to verify base fee is destroyed (no AddBalance to coinbase). 3. Trace EDGE-1559-PAY to verify only priority fee goes to coinbase. 4. Check state_transition.go for correct fee handling. 5. Verify effectiveGasTip calculation: min(maxPriorityFee, maxFee - baseFee).
checklist.notes: Base fee MUST be burned. Priority fee MUST go to coinbase. Incorrect routing affects supply and miner incentives.

checklist.title: EIP-7702 EOA code delegation authorization security
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 7 nodes in GRAPH-EIP-7702-SETCODE. 2. Locate authorization verification in core/state_transition.go. 3. Verify ACTION-7702-VERIFY-SIGNATURE uses secp256k1 ECDSA recovery. 4. Confirm ACTION-7702-CHECK-CHAIN-ID validates chain ID matches or is 0 (wildcard). 5. Check ACTION-7702-CHECK-NONCE validates nonce matches account nonce or is 0. 6. Verify signature covers (chain_id, address, nonce) tuple.
checklist.notes: EIP-7702 Prague+ allows EOAs to delegate to code. Critical: signature MUST be verified before delegation. Nonce prevents replay.

checklist.title: EIP-7702 sequential authorization verification
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 7 edges in GRAPH-EIP-7702-SETCODE. 2. Verify each authorization in tx.AuthorizationList is processed independently. 3. Confirm failed authorization does not affect subsequent authorizations. 4. Check EDGE-7702-VERIFY must complete before EDGE-7702-SET. 5. Verify per-authorization gas charging (PER_AUTH_BASE_COST = 2500).
checklist.notes: Each authorization is independent. One failure should not prevent others. Gas is charged per authorization regardless of success.

checklist.title: EIP-3860 initcode size limit enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 7 nodes in GRAPH-EIP-3860-INITCODE. 2. Locate MAX_INITCODE_SIZE constant (49152 bytes). 3. Verify STATE-3860-INITCODE-EXCEEDS-LIMIT rejects transactions immediately. 4. Check size validation happens before gas charging in ACTION-3860-CHECK-INITCODE-SIZE. 5. Verify applies to both CREATE and CREATE2 opcodes.
checklist.notes: EIP-3860 Shanghai+ limits initcode to 49152 bytes. Size check MUST precede gas calculation. Prevents DoS via jumpdest analysis.

checklist.title: EIP-3860 initcode gas metering (2 gas per 32-byte word)
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 6 edges from EDGE-3860-BEGIN-CHECK to EDGE-3860-GAS-CHARGED. 2. Verify gas formula: INITCODE_WORD_COST (2) * ceil(len(initcode)/32). 3. Confirm gas is charged AFTER size validation but BEFORE execution. 4. Check edge ordering: size check -> gas calculation -> gas deduction -> execution.
checklist.notes: INITCODE_WORD_COST = 2 gas per 32-byte word. Size check fails before gas is touched. Gas calculation uses ceiling division.

checklist.title: EIP-4895 withdrawal processing unconditional success
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 7 nodes in GRAPH-EIP-4895-WITHDRAWALS. 2. Verify ACTION-4895-CREDIT-BALANCE uses AddBalance which cannot fail. 3. Confirm withdrawals consume no gas. 4. Check ACTION-4895-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWALS-ROOT verifies Merkle root against header. 5. Verify order preservation in STATE-4895-ITERATING-WITHDRAWALS.
checklist.notes: Shanghai+ withdrawals are system-level credits. They MUST succeed unconditionally. No gas consumed. Root validation is consensus-critical.

checklist.title: EIP-4895 withdrawal root validation before processing
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 7 edges from EDGE-4895-VALIDATE-ROOT to EDGE-4895-DONE. 2. Verify root validation occurs BEFORE any balance credits. 3. Confirm EDGE-4895-ROOT-INVALID rejects entire block. 4. Check withdrawals trie construction matches header.WithdrawalsHash. 5. Verify iteration order matches withdrawal index.
checklist.notes: Withdrawal root is committed in block header. Mismatch invalidates block. Processing order must match committed order.

checklist.title: BLOBBASEFEE opcode returns correct blob base fee
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 5 nodes in GRAPH-EIP-7516-BLOBBASEFEE. 2. Locate opBlobBaseFee handler in core/vm/instructions.go. 3. Verify value read from evm.Context.BlobBaseFee. 4. Confirm BlobBaseFee is set at block start from header. 5. Check ACTION-7516-PUSH-VALUE pushes correct uint256 value.
checklist.notes: EIP-7516 Cancun+ BLOBBASEFEE opcode. Value set from block header at EVM creation. 2 gas cost (GasQuickStep).

checklist.title: BLOBBASEFEE gas charging before value access
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 4 edges from EDGE-7516-GAS to EDGE-7516-DONE. 2. Verify 2 gas (GasQuickStep) is charged before accessing BlobBaseFee. 3. Confirm gas check happens before stack push. 4. Check for proper stack overflow protection.
checklist.notes: GasQuickStep = 2 gas. Simple opcode with no arguments. Gas-first execution model applies.

checklist.title: EIP-4788 beacon root ring buffer storage
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 11 nodes in GRAPH-EIP-4788-BEACON-ROOT. 2. Verify ring buffer size is 8191 slots. 3. Check ACTION-4788-COMPUTE-SLOT-INDEX: slot = timestamp % 8191. 4. Verify ACTION-4788-STORE-TIMESTAMP stores at slot, ACTION-4788-STORE-ROOT at slot + 8191. 5. Confirm ACTION-4788-VERIFY-TIMESTAMP on query prevents stale reads.
checklist.notes: EIP-4788 Cancun+ stores parent beacon block roots. Ring buffer prevents state bloat. Timestamp verification critical for freshness.

checklist.title: EIP-4788 system call at block start and query verification
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 9-11 edges in GRAPH-EIP-4788-BEACON-ROOT. 2. Verify EDGE-4788-SYSTEM-CALL executes before any user transactions. 3. Confirm system call is from SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffe). 4. Check EDGE-4788-VERIFY validates timestamp match on query. 5. Verify EDGE-4788-MISMATCH returns empty for stale timestamps.
checklist.notes: System call executes at block start. Query returns parent beacon root only if timestamp matches. Stale queries return empty.

checklist.title: EIP-6110 validator deposit parsing from logs
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 7 nodes in GRAPH-EIP-6110-DEPOSITS. 2. Locate deposit contract address and DepositEvent signature. 3. Verify ACTION-6110-FILTER-LOGS uses exact address and topic match. 4. Check ACTION-6110-VALIDATE-LOG-FORMAT verifies 192-byte payload. 5. Confirm deposit order matches receipt log order.
checklist.notes: EIP-6110 Prague+ collects validator deposits on EL. Order preserved for CL processing. Log format strictly validated.

checklist.title: EIP-6110 deposit log format validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 7 edges from EDGE-6110-FILTER to EDGE-6110-DONE. 2. Verify EDGE-6110-VALIDATE checks 192-byte payload structure. 3. Confirm EDGE-6110-INVALID rejects malformed deposits. 4. Check deposit data extraction: pubkey (48), withdrawal_credentials (32), amount (8), signature (96), index (8).
checklist.notes: Deposit log must be exactly 192 bytes. Invalid format is ignored (not error). Strict parsing prevents malformed deposits.

checklist.title: EIP-7002 execution layer triggered exits fee mechanism
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 13 nodes in GRAPH-EIP-7002-WITHDRAWALS. 2. Verify ACTION-7002-CHECK-FEE uses exponential pricing to prevent spam. 3. Confirm ACTION-7002-DEQUEUE-REQUESTS dequeues max 16 per block. 4. Check ACTION-7002-UPDATE-EXCESS tracks request count for pricing. 5. Verify fee formula: fee = MIN_FEE * e^(excess / ADJUSTMENT_QUOTIENT).
checklist.notes: EIP-7002 Prague+ allows validators to exit via EL. Fee prevents spam. Max 16 dequeued per block. System call at block end.

checklist.title: EIP-7002 withdrawal request input validation and fee checking
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 11-12 edges in GRAPH-EIP-7002-WITHDRAWALS. 2. Verify EDGE-7002-VALIDATE checks 56-byte input (pubkey + amount). 3. Confirm EDGE-7002-CHECK-FEE enforces minimum fee payment. 4. Check EDGE-7002-FEE-FAIL reverts on insufficient fee. 5. Verify EDGE-7002-ENQUEUE adds to queue only after validation.
checklist.notes: Input: 48-byte pubkey + 8-byte amount. Fee must be paid in value. Queue insertion only after validation.

checklist.title: EIP-7251 validator consolidation requests
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review all 13 nodes in GRAPH-EIP-7251-CONSOLIDATIONS. 2. Verify MAX_CONSOLIDATION_REQUESTS_PER_BLOCK = 2. 3. Check exponential fee pricing similar to EIP-7002. 4. Confirm consolidation request stores source and target pubkeys. 5. Verify system call at block end dequeues and exports requests.
checklist.notes: EIP-7251 Prague+ increases MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE. Consolidation allows merging validators. Max 2 per block prevents abuse.
